description: Comprehensive directory of Danish churches (kirker) covering all 10 Danish dioceses (stifter) of Folkekirken (Church of Denmark) — Aalborg, Aarhus, Fyens, Haderslev, Helsingør, Københavns, Lolland-Falsters, Ribe, Roskilde, Viborg — plus cathedrals (domkirker), protected churches (fredede kirker), royal burial churches (kongers gravkirker), decommissioned churches (nedlagte kirker), and Folkekirken parent category. Resolved against Wikidata for canonical QIDs, multilingual names (38 langs), descriptions (5 langs), reference-property labels (country/diocese/religion/architect/etc.), coordinates, year of inception, images, and 35-lang Wikipedia sitelinks.
